'''Operation Clean Sweep''' was an operation undertaken by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces to eliminate three [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents in [[Geharr]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The operation was masterminded by [[Bleshk Callor]].<ref name="GeharrIncident" />
